name: detent-dial
title: Detent Dial
description: Turn the dial with the arrow keys or a swipe
useCases: On a synthesizer panel, a musician turns a dial to select one of eleven effect levels.
In a lamp prototype, a designer selects a brightness step. The app maps the 0–10 position to a light output level.
task: Turn the dial with the arrow keys or a swipe
behavior: The dial selects a value from 0 to 10. Convert the position into application units in onChange.
